secureConfigurationGuidance.accessRequestInstructions: The Secure Configuration Guide is not served at a public URL. It is shared in the same 90-day document grant as the SOC 2 Type II package: one reusable link, provisioned once per necessary party from the trust center landing page, that opens the SOC 2 report, bridge letter, audit engagement letter, renewal schedule and the Secure Configuration Guide together. The link renews itself: its holder sends a POST to the link's /renew address from 14 days before it expires until 30 days after, and receives a new 90-day link with no approval. Every access of the link is logged. No NDA or terms apply, and there is no per-access request or approval.

trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: No account, NDA or terms are required. The certification package files (package index, Security Decision Record, Ongoing Certification Report sample and incident-report samples) are public at the URLs listed in additionalRepositories and may be fetched anonymously by any HTTP client. The SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, audit engagement letter and renewal schedule, together with the Secure Configuration Guide, are shared as one document grant, provisioned once per necessary party: request the first link from the trust center landing page form (name, email, company, purpose); the System Owner issues it within one business day. The link is reusable and lasts 90 days; its holder renews it without approval by sending a POST to the link's /renew address from 14 days before it expires until 30 days after, so access is never interrupted by an approval step. Every access of the link is logged. No NDA or terms apply.

certified.useCase: FedRAMP-authorized IaaS providing the compute, storage, and networking that hosts the DZTE service within the U.S. Government-only AWS GovCloud region.

FedRAMP-authorized SIEM/SOAR platform providing security information and event management (SIEM) and security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) for continuous security monitoring of the DZTE service.
Corporate identity, email, and collaboration services supporting Dispel personnel who operate and administer the DZTE service.
FedRAMP-authorized Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) providing continuous threat monitoring and response for the DZTE service infrastructure and administrative endpoints.
